description: Named evidence-layer configurations for reproducible ablation experiments. For each config, run the system under test with only the listed evidence tables/documents visible, then score against ground_truth/solutions/*.json using the standard metrics in README.md.

full.note: every evidence table + documents + new modalities (SIM/IMEI, CCTV/ANPR, hashes)

no_documents.note: structured evidence only, no FIR/witness narrative text

no_cctv_anpr.note: isolates the value of the CCTV/ANPR modality specifically
